question.prompt: Three fourths of a pitcher is filled with pineapple juice. The pitcher is emptied by pouring an equal amount of juice into each of \(5\) cups. What percent of the total capacity of the pitcher did each cup receive?

solutions.explanation:
The juice occupies \(\frac34\) of the pitcher's total capacity. Sharing that juice equally among \(5\) cups gives each cup

\[
\frac34\div5=\frac3{20}=\frac{15}{100}
\]

of the pitcher's capacity. That is \(\boxed{15\%}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\). The reference whole remains the full pitcher, even though the pitcher was only partly filled.
solutions.title: Divide the filled fraction equally among five cups
